concerns.text: Task T041 generates 'manually labeled' comments via an inline deterministic script. This violates FR-013 and US-4 which require a 'manually labeled subset' (human annotation) to validate VADER thresholds. A synthetic script cannot validate human alignment (Cohen's Kappa) as it creates a tautological loop where the 'ground truth' is defined by the same logic being tested.

Task T028b allows 'hardcoding' a statistical noise threshold if the pilot run is inconclusive. This violates Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) and Principle I (Reproducibility), which mandate that all derived numbers must trace to code execution or cited models, not hardcoded constants introduced as fallbacks.

Task T051 schedules the correction of the correlation target (from static metric to 'Fairness Degradation Slopes') in the final 'Polish' phase. This creates a semantic violation where the implementation tasks (T032-T036) execute against a contradictory spec for the majority of the timeline, risking the delivery of a model that does not satisfy the amended FR-006/SC-001.

Task T041b enforces a hard pre-condition that 'data/raw' must contain 100 repositories, failing the pipeline if not met. This contradicts the spec's Edge Cases and SC-005 which require the system to handle data scarcity gracefully (e.g., 'No Analyzable Code' status) rather than halting execution.

Task T026 performs the independence diff check but lacks a defined pass/fail gate in the task description. SC-004 requires 'zero token overlap' as a verification step; without an explicit failure condition or pipeline gate in the task, the acceptance criterion is not preserved in the implementation plan.
